3310546.note: The 65th Tamna Culture Festival runs Oct 17–21, 2026. The main venue has moved to Citizens' Welfare Town Plaza in Jeju City (in 2025 it was the Tapdong seafront). The opening ceremony is on Oct 17 at 7:30 pm, and this year the festival coincides with the National Sports Festival held in Jeju, so expect Jeju City to be busier than usual.

intro.fee: KRW 30,000; KRW 25,000 for groups of 20 or more, youth, people with disabilities and national merit recipients

1084180.note: The 2026 Jeju Olle Walking Festival runs Nov 5–7 on Olle Routes 19 and 20. Day 1: opening at Jocheon Sports Ground, then 13 km to Dongbok-ri Sports Park. Day 2: Dongbok-ri Sports Park to Jeju Batdam Theme Park (11.5 km). Day 3: Jeju Haenyeo Anti-Japanese Movement Memorial Park back to Jeju Batdam Theme Park (12.9 km). Pre-registration period: Jul 8 – Oct 9, 2026, in the official Olle Pass app — foreign visitors register in the same app. The organizers say this is the last edition in the three-day, one-route format; from 2027 the festival is planned to spread across 23 routes over 25 days.
1084180.noteFoot: Checked against two reports of the organizer's announcement (Seoul Shinmun 2026-07-08, Jnuri 2026-07). The participation fee appears in one of them only — confirm in the Olle Pass app.

intro.playtime: 9:00 am – 2:00 pm on each walk day

3364856.note: The walk is held on three separate days, not continuously: Sep 19 (Gapyeong, meeting at Gapyeong Station), Oct 10 (Pocheon, Hantangang River UNESCO Global Geopark) and Nov 7, 2026 (Chuncheon, meeting at Chuncheon Station). Each walk runs 9 am – 2 pm. It is free for ages 8 and up, with online registration on the Han River Watershed Management Committee website (hanriver.or.kr). Every participant gets a tote bag and a souvenir; finishing all three courses earns a completion badge.
3364856.noteFoot: Source: Han River Watershed Management Committee official event page, checked Oct 7, 2026.

1037621.note: Pohang City has set the 2026 festival for Nov 19–21 around Yeongildae Beach — later than usual, because the early-summer slot clashed with the June local elections. Nov 19: a media-art lighting ceremony at Songdo Pier. Nov 20: a fireworks street parade with groups from all 29 town and neighborhood districts. Nov 21: the main fireworks show over Yeongildae Beach from 8 pm for about an hour, with teams from Korea, Japan and France and a finale by Korea's Hanwha. Road closures, shuttles and viewing areas had not been announced as of Oct 21, 2026.
1037621.noteFoot: Source: News1, Oct 19, 2026, citing Pohang City. Checked Oct 21, 2026.
1037621.desc: Nov 19–21, 2026 · Pohang. Main fireworks show Nov 21 from 8 pm over Yeongildae Beach (Korea, Japan, France, Hanwha finale); street parade Nov 20.

intro.place: Lotte Garden Park area in Jangyu, Gimhae (next to Lotte Premium Outlets Gimhae)

697445.note: The 31st edition runs Nov 6–10, 2026 and, for the first time in its 31 years, moves out of Jillye (the Buncheong Ceramics Museum area) to Lotte Garden Park next to Lotte Premium Outlets Gimhae in Jangyu. Expect potters' exhibitions and sales, clay-shaping workshops, a traditional kiln firing and large-scale pottery demonstrations. Shuttle and parking details had not been announced as of Oct 14, 2026, and older pages on the festival site still describe the Jillye venue.
697445.noteFoot: Sources: official festival site main page (festival.buncheong.co.kr); Newspim and Gimhae Ilbo, Oct 12, 2026.
697445.desc: Nov 6–10, 2026 · Gimhae. The Buncheong pottery festival moves to Lotte Garden Park in Jangyu this year: potters' market, clay workshops, a kiln firing.

4076928.note: The autumn edition runs Oct 17–25, 2026 at seven Hangang parks (including Jamwon, Ttukseom, Banpo and Gangseo) and on the river itself. Highlights: The Road Chef Hangang, a K-street-food truck contest by 20 young chefs at the Ttukseom Hangang Park swimming pool (Oct 23, 5–9 pm; Oct 24, 1–9 pm; Oct 25, 1–8 pm; free entry); yacht rides (20,000–31,000 won, 2–10 pm) and kayaking (12,500–30,000 won, 2–5:30 pm) at Sebitseom in Banpo; and a free zipline and tree-climbing course at Gangseo Hangang Park on Oct 24–25, 1–5 pm. For Ttukseom, Jayang Station (Line 7) exits 2 and 3 lead straight into the park. For questions in English, call the Seoul city help line 120.
4076928.noteFoot: Sources: Seoul Metropolitan Government festival site and official leaflet (seoul.go.kr/festa/hangang), Seoul Media Hub. Checked Oct 14, 2026.
4076928.desc: Oct 17–25, 2026 · Seoul. Autumn festival at 7 Hangang parks: free K-street-food truck contest at Ttukseom, yacht and kayak at Banpo, zipline in Gangseo.

1675246.note: The 18th Gangneung Coffee Festival runs Oct 21–25, 2026, 10 am–8 pm, on Gangneung Coffee Street at Anmok Beach. From Gangneung Station, city buses 212 and 212-1 go to Anmok; the organizer asks visitors to come by public transport. Free to enjoy: a beach photo zone built from two tonnes of coffee beans, open-air cafés, coffee busking (11 am, 2 pm, 4 pm and 6:30 pm) and tastings from local Gangneung cafés (11 am, 1 pm, 3 pm and 6 pm, near the main information booth). The paid Barista's Table session (20,000 won, 30 seats) runs at 2 pm on Oct 21, 22, 23 and 25 at the Global Coffee Lounge.
1675246.noteFoot: Source: official festival site coffeefestival.net (overview, transport and program pages). Checked Oct 14, 2026.
1675246.desc: Oct 21–25, 2026 · Gangneung. Coffee Street at Anmok Beach, 10 am–8 pm: free café tastings, a coffee-bean photo zone, busking. Bus 212 from the station.

293231.note: The 25th Seoul Silver Grass Festival runs Oct 17–23, 2026, 10 am – 9 pm, across Haneul Park in World Cup Park (Mapo-gu). Seoul City asks visitors to come by public transport because the roads get very congested: get off at World Cup Stadium or Mapo-gu Office Station (Line 6) and walk up (about 40 minutes), or take the small electric shuttle (the 'Maengkkongi' e-car) from the Nanjicheon Park car park.
293231.noteFoot: Source: Seoul Metropolitan Government environment news page, posted Sep 28, 2026. Checked Oct 21, 2026.
293231.desc: Oct 17–23, 2026 · Seoul. Silver grass fields on Haneul Park, open 10 am–9 pm. Line 6 World Cup Stadium Stn, then a 40-min walk up or the e-car shuttle.

1853185.note: The 23rd Iksan Chrysanthemum Festival (billed as 'Ten Million Chrysanthemums') runs Oct 23 – Nov 1, 2026 at Jungang Sports Park, Sinheung Neighborhood Park and around Iksan Station; the chrysanthemum sculptures stay on display until Nov 8. After dark there are interactive light installations and a chrysanthemum light tunnel, with EDM parties and circus shows planned for the evenings and fireworks on Oct 31. A sweet-potato zone lets children dig up and carry sweet potatoes. Opening hours, admission and parking were not given in the city's announcement.
1853185.noteFoot: Source: Inews24, Oct 14, 2026 (Iksan City press conference). Checked Oct 21, 2026.

1244634.note: The 26th Masan Gagopa Chrysanthemum Festival runs Oct 31 – Nov 8, 2026, and admission is free. This year it spreads along the waterfront across three areas: 3·15 Marine Nuri Park (about 100,000 chrysanthemum pots), Happo Waterfront Park and Masan Marine New Town. Its signature piece is a single chrysanthemum plant trained to carry 1,540 blooms, a Guinness World Record. The opening night starts with fireworks, and on the evening of Nov 4 a nakhwa ('falling fire') show is held over the sea for the first time, with more than 1,500 hanging fire sticks burning for about an hour. Changwon City provides about 5,500 parking spaces across the three sites and a free shuttle from Masan Station, but the weekday shuttle stops at 6 pm.
1244634.noteFoot: Source: Maeil Shinmun, Oct 16, 2026. Checked Oct 21, 2026.
1244634.desc: Oct 31 – Nov 8, 2026 · Changwon (Masan). Free chrysanthemum festival on the waterfront; first nakhwa fire show over the sea Nov 4. Free shuttle from Masan Stn.
